name: What steps are involved in a cash home sale?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a cash home sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally involves receiving a cash offer, accepting it, conducting a home inspection, reviewing title, and then closing. Unlike traditional sales, there's no mortgage lender involved, which eliminates loan approval timelines. Your agent will guide you through each stage, ensuring all necessary disclosures and documents are handled promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Steps include offer, acceptance, inspection, title review, and closing, with no loan approval delays.
